author: unmoving323
quote:
We waited 13 years for this. Thirteen. And the big new thing is that you play as a guy whose main job is being a good boyfriend. Fix the house, stock the fridge, buy her flowers and a necklace, pick up her clothes, get a haircut so she likes how you look, hold hands, text her back, watch little hearts pop up when you do a good job. That’s the content. That’s what they spent all that time ****’s a girlfriend simulator with guns. Lucia gets out of prison and Jason’s out here doing chores so the relationship meter goes up. “Lucia will appreciate this.” Cool. 

After 13 years I wanted chaos, not a dating sim where the male lead’s early missions are making the place nice for his girl. No hookers either, they said they wanted to focus on the couple. So the series that used to let you be the worst person alive is now about nurturing your bond and not being a bad partner. 

The map looks good. The cars look good. None of that matters when the fantasy is “be a thoughtful boyfriend in Vice City.” If I wanted to do groceries and manage feelings I wouldn’t have bought Grand Theft Auto. This is woke trash that forgot what the series was. 0.
